candidates.topic: Five Planets Retrograde — Venus Retrograde in Scorpio Spotlight
candidates.teaser: Five planets are retrograde right now — but one of them is doing something to your relationships that you won't see coming.
candidates.video_description: Venus is retrograde in Scorpio right now, and with four other planets also moving backward, October 2026 is one of the most internally charged periods of the year. Astrologers say this is a time of deep reckoning, not outward progress.
candidates.script: Five planets are retrograde right now — and most people have no idea. Venus, Saturn, Uranus, Neptune, Pluto — all moving backward. But Venus retrograde in Scorpio is the one astrologers say hits the hardest. In traditional astrology, Venus rules love, money, and self-worth. In Scorpio, it digs into what you've buried. Old relationships resurface. Hidden desires get louder. This isn't chaos — it's a reckoning. What are you pretending you're over?

candidates.topic: Waning Crescent Moon in Virgo — Release and Purge
candidates.teaser: The Waning Crescent Moon in Virgo is asking you to let go of something specific — and most people are holding on to the wrong thing.
candidates.video_title: Waning Crescent in Virgo — Let This Go Now
candidates.video_description: The Moon is in Virgo during its Waning Crescent phase, a time astrologers associate with release, rest, and clearing out what no longer serves. Paired with the Sun in Libra, the tension between perfectionism and balance is at its peak.
candidates.script: The Waning Crescent Moon in Virgo is the most overlooked moon phase — and it might be the most powerful. In astrology, this phase is the final exhale before the new cycle begins. Virgo energy wants to analyze, fix, and perfect. But the waning crescent says stop. Release. Not everything needs to be solved before you let it go. The Sun is in Libra, searching for balance — and balance starts with knowing what to put down. What are you still carrying?

candidates.topic: Mercury in Scorpio — Before the Retrograde
candidates.teaser: Mercury just moved into Scorpio — and in 17 days it goes retrograde. What happens between now and then changes everything.
candidates.video_title: Mercury in Scorpio — 17 Days Before Retrograde
candidates.video_description: Mercury is currently at 9.2° Scorpio and heading toward its retrograde station on October 24, 2026. Astrologers call this the pre-retrograde shadow — conversations started now may need to be revisited, revised, or completely undone.
candidates.script: Mercury goes retrograde in Scorpio on October 24th — that's 17 days from now. And what you say between now and then? You might be taking it back. Mercury in Scorpio doesn't do surface-level conversation. It probes. It uncovers. It says the thing people were too polite to say. Astrologers call this window the shadow period — what gets started now gets complicated later. Be precise. Be honest. Or be ready to explain yourself.

candidates.topic: Saturn Retrograde in Aries — The Discipline Paradox
candidates.teaser: Saturn retrograde in Aries is exposing a discipline trap — and the harder you push right now, the worse it gets.
candidates.video_title: Saturn Retrograde in Aries — Stop Forcing It
candidates.video_description: Saturn is retrograde at 11° Aries, a sign known for impulse and forward momentum — which creates a fundamental tension. Astrologers interpret this transit as a period where forced ambition backfires and internal restructuring is the only real path forward.
candidates.script: Saturn retrograde in Aries sounds like a contradiction — and astrologers say that's exactly the point. Aries wants to charge forward. Saturn says slow down and rebuild the foundation. When Saturn goes retrograde, the structures you've been forcing start to crack. Not because you failed — because they were built on the wrong blueprint. This is the review, not the result. The ambition isn't wrong. The timing and the structure might be. What are you forcing that needs to be redesigned?

candidates.topic: Mars in Leo Conjunct Jupiter in Leo — Rare Fire Surge
candidates.teaser: Mars and Jupiter are both in Leo right now — astrologers say this combination only comes around every twelve years, and it's building toward something.
candidates.video_title: Mars Conjunct Jupiter in Leo — This Is Rare
candidates.video_description: Mars sits at 5.6° Leo while Jupiter is at 20.8° Leo — both in the sign of performance, ambition, and ego. In astrology, Mars-Jupiter conjunctions are considered high-energy, high-risk transits that amplify action, confidence, and sometimes overreach.
candidates.script: Mars and Jupiter are both in Leo right now — and astrologers say when these two meet in the same sign, the energy is almost impossible to ignore. Mars is raw drive. Jupiter is expansion. Leo is the stage. Together, in traditional astrology, this is the combination behind bold moves, big risks, and breakthroughs — but also spectacular overcorrections. The ambition in the room right now is real. The question is whether you're building something that lasts or just performing confidence. Which one is it for you?
